name: ConvertX
short_desc: Self-hosted converter for over 1,000 file formats
description: Convert images, documents, video, audio, ebooks and many other formats in your browser. ConvertX supports batch processing, user accounts and persistent conversion history.
author: C4illin

form_fields.label: Maximum Parallel Conversions
form_fields.hint: Limit concurrent conversion jobs to control CPU and memory use. Set 0 for unlimited.

form_fields.label: Temporary File Cleanup Interval (hours)
form_fields.hint: Files older than this interval are deleted. Set 0 to disable automatic cleanup.

form_fields.label: Container User ID
form_fields.hint: UID for app data files. The default matches common Runtipi app data ownership.

form_fields.label: Container Group ID
form_fields.hint: GID for app data files. Adjust only if your host uses a different data directory group.
